description: Reconcile a trade blotter against a broker file, reporting missing trades and value mismatches. At end of day, when the blotter must be tied to the broker's record. Do not choose this when partial fills or allocation differences must be modelled. Example requests: Reconcile my trade blotter against the broker file. | Which trades do not match the broker? | Find the breaks in this trade file.

accepted_price.description: The quoted amount, echoed exactly; checked against the quote.

authorized_by.description: Identifier of the human or agent authorizing this job.

buyer_token.description: The buyer_token returned with your first purchase. It opens the purchase history for that buyer, including earlier deliverables.

idempotency_key.description: Retry key; the same key returns the same job.

blotter.description: The customer's blotter.csv, as text. Supported: CSV with a header row. The internal blotter. Maximum 1048576 bytes.

broker.description: The customer's broker.csv, as text. Supported: CSV with a header row. The broker file. Maximum 1048576 bytes.

payment_signature.description: x402 payment payload; required for a priced capability (see submit_job).

quote_id.description: The quote_id from POST /v1/jobs; required when priced.

name: submit_trade_blotter_reconciler
title: Trade blotter reconciler
